scope: Synthetic purchase-text extraction, not photo recognition
hardware: Existing RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, 8188 MiB reported device memory

training.note: The parity preflight sets torch.manual_seed(17) after set_seed(29). The original run metadata's seed=29 is the sampling seed, not the final torch RNG seed. Source now also records this distinction explicitly.
training.wallTimeNote: Training wall time includes generation-based validation and other execution delays; it is not GPU kernel time.

evaluation.gpuJobs: Sequential, after training finishes; Ollama model unloaded
evaluation.latency: One uncached pass per method, same device, no fixed GPU clock or randomized method order; each run includes its first generation call but reports model loading separately.
evaluation.rawPredictions: No failed document is dropped. Invalid results count as empty in usable garment metrics.
evaluation.testPolicy: New model checkpoint selection uses validation only. No training changes are made from final-test or diagnostic failures.
evaluation.timingClarification: The frozen dataset manifest's test-after-selection wording refers to candidate model evaluation. The deterministic CPU parser baseline was scored earlier while training ran; its results did not change the fixed training schedule, data or selection rule. Dataset integrity/contract tests inspect labels without training on them.
evaluation.oldTest: The v1 60-document test is exposed and used only for regression.
evaluation.freshTest: 100 synthetic receipts, 112 garments, 672 fields, shared vocabulary but disjoint template families.
evaluation.providerBaseline: The old v1 adapter is evaluated using its original whole-receipt protocol. The untuned v2 base uses the same per-line protocol as the new adapter.

deployment: No production migration, credential change, wardrobe insertion or automatic model promotion is part of this experiment.
